probeInputs.quietTerminal: state s=0 -> quiet q emits DATA99 only when its input terminal arrives -> manual-COMPLETE dependent d. Activate d, clear observations, complete s. Count d invocations and its waves/terminal.
probeInputs.observeStop: state s=0 -> n emits separate DATA1 and DATA2 arrays only when s=1. Install observe first and ordinary subscribe second on the same n. Each stops itself on DATA1. Set s=1; record observer DATA values.
probeInputs.subscribeStop: Same graph and source write as observeStop; record the ordinary subscriber DATA values after it requests its own unsubscribe on DATA1.
probeInputs.emptyDown: Activate a silent zero-dependency node and keep its ctx (Rust DeferredCtx). Clear initial subscriber arrays, call down([]) after invocation return, count delivered arrays.
probeInputs.lateAfterCommitFailure: Activate a silent node and keep its ctx. In a batch body stage an updater on state s=0 that throws, then request late DATA42 from the kept ctx. Catch commit failure and record node DATA values.
probeInputs.replaceCleanup: State ledger=0; zero-dependency n setup stores private state42 and returns cleanup that writes the retiring ctx state to ledger. Activate n, subscribe ledger and clear initial snapshot, replace n with a silent instance; record ledger DATA values.
probeInputs.endedBatch: States trigger=0, a=0, b=0. In trigger subscriber for DATA1, queue a.complete(), then batch: stage b updater first, a updater second; both increment a shared counter and return1. Set trigger=1. Report updaterRuns, b retained value and host report count.
probeInputs.checkpointMissingRecipe: Create cold silent zero-dependency node n with recipe ref absent; do not retain/subscribe. Capture and restore with an empty registry. Record the exact refusal.
probeInputs.quietError: For each INVALIDATE policy auto/manual and retained true/false: states a=1,b=1; quiet q(a) emits its input DATA only when retained=true; ordinary d(q,b) emits sum only when both have values. Subscribe d, clear observations; batch invalidate(a), error(a, boom), set(b,2). Record downstream DATA values and non-PENDING event tags. No DATA3; retained case INVALIDATE then ERROR, empty case RESOLVED (d settles the b wave without DATA) then ERROR. ERROR remains lifetime-bound.
